sentences.text: Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she lost her husband Ron on May the ninth.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated they were married for fifty-two years.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated Ron won prizes for his dahlias at the show.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she cannot get into the bath and now performs a strip wash at the sink.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she goes up the stairs on her bottom some days.
Karen Wells (S3) stated her mother nearly fell in October on the landing.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she bruised her arm after the fall but did not go to hospital.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she eats what Karen brings, doing only a bit of soup or a sandwich.
Karen Wells (S3) stated she found Doreen's dinner yesterday.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she would go to the lunch club at St Anne's on Wednesdays.
Karen Wells (S3) offered to drive Doreen Abbott to the lunch club the first time.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has been feeling lonely, with long and quiet days and nobody to talk to.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has been putting by about forty tablets since the summer.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has been saving her tablets, not taking them, and keeping them.
Karen Wells (S3) stated she found the tablets on Sunday, hidden in Doreen's bedside drawer in an envelope under her handkerchiefs, and took them home in her bag.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has no other tablets saved anywhere else in the house.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she would stop eating if she were ever put in a home.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she wants to stay at home with Ron's things and will only eat as long as she is there.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she would be better off dead.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she did not know if she had thought about ending her life.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has her pension and a council benefit from her late husband Ron, and that Karen does the bills on the computer.
Karen Wells (S3) stated she sorted the bank account after the funeral and that Doreen is fine for money.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she would ring Karen or the crisis line if she felt like that again, especially at night.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) agreed to refer Doreen Abbott to Dr Patel's surgery today or tomorrow.
Karen Wells (S3) agreed to take the saved tablets to the pharmacy today and sort weekly packs from Kestle Pharmacy.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) agreed to refer for a stairlift assessment and a bath seat.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) agreed to ask about a carer in the mornings for washing, with Doreen stating she does not want strangers every day.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) agreed to ring Dr Patel's surgery when he leaves that afternoon.
Gareth Lloyd (S1) agreed to refer for a stairlift by Friday and return on Tuesday 1 December.
